name: suchen.tv Streaming Widget
author: suchentv

sections.description:
Show your readers where to watch legally in Germany – free Mediathek first.

The suchen.tv widget highlights German public media libraries first, then paid flatrate, rent or buy. Ideal if your site cares about kostenlos streamen and legal free options – not only subscription logos.

Why blogs install it

  • Mediathek-first: Free offers are surfaced before subscriptions
  • Live DE availability – no stale “where to stream” paragraphs
  • Block editor + shortcodes – insert under a review in seconds
  • After activation a published page Kostenlose Mediathek is created (search, categories, top films, leaving soon)
  • Optional Redaktionstipps: your curated lists, live offers from suchen.tv
  • Light theme by default, Schema.org Offers, lazy iframe – blog-friendly & DSGVO-aware

Redaktionstipps – your lists, live free + paid offers

Build curated movie lists under suchen.tv → Listen. Embed them as Redaktionstipps; readers still see Mediathek-first availability where it exists.

  • Max. 10 lists × 20 titles each
  • Search & add titles in the admin UI
  • Block suchen.tv Redaktionstipps or [suchentv_picks list="meine-horror"]
  • Only titles with posters; offers update automatically

Features

  • Blocks: Streaming Widget, Listen-Widget, Startseite, Redaktionstipps
  • Shortcodes: [suchentv], [suchentv_hub], [suchentv_list], [suchentv_picks]
  • Layouts: compact / standard / detail / card
  • Themes: light (default) / dark
  • Schema.org JSON-LD (Movie/TVSeries + Offers)
  • Lazy-Load iframe, auto height, oEmbed, block patterns
  • Partner ID, optional consent notice, Site Health check
  • Optional: hide suchen.tv branding (readers stay on the blog)
  • Admin guide: suchen.tv → Anleitung
  • Updates: new ZIP from suchen.tv/embed, or wordpress.org once listed (no self-update ping)

External service

  • HTTPS iframes from suchen.tv (/widget/stream-box, /widget/list-box, /widget/picks, /widget/hub)
  • Editor search via WP REST proxy
  • Optional Schema fetch to suchen.tv API (cached 12h)
  • Privacy: https://suchen.tv/datenschutz · https://suchen.tv/impressum · https://suchen.tv/embed

Trademarks

This plugin is not affiliated with Netflix, Amazon, Disney, Joyn, ARD, ZDF, Arte or other providers. Those names appear only to identify availability lists (“list for …”). All trademarks belong to their owners.
sections.installation:
1. Install & activate. A published page Kostenlose Mediathek is created. The WordPress homepage and menus are not changed. Optionally tick “use as homepage” under suchen.tv → Settings.
  2. Open suchen.tv → Anleitung for the click-by-click guide (H1, category blurbs, editorial lists).
  3. Optional: add the page to a menu, or embed extra widgets with /suchen / [suchentv id="550"].
  4. Optional: suchen.tv → Listen – default list “Redaktionstipps” is created automatically; tick “show on homepage”.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin create a page?

Yes. On activation it publishes Kostenlose Mediathek (search + live rails, Mediathek first). Homepage and menus stay yours. Optionally tick “Als WordPress-Homepage verwenden”. Draft the page under suchen.tv → Settings.

Where do I edit the homepage headline?

suchen.tv → Einstellungen (H1, intro, description per category). Some block themes hide page content on the front page – that is expected.

Does it show free Mediathek offers?

Yes. Free / Mediathek offers are prioritized in the widget when available for the title in Germany. Paid flatrate, rent and buy follow.

Can I show my own film recommendations?

Yes. A default list Redaktionstipps is created on first visit. Add more lists under suchen.tv → Listen, tick “Auf Startseite zeigen”, or embed with the Redaktionstipps block / [suchentv_picks] on a normal page (not the hub homepage).

Does the plugin work offline without suchen.tv?

No. Widget content is provided by suchen.tv as a documented third-party service.

How do plugin updates work?

Download a new ZIP from https://suchen.tv/embed or, once listed, update via wordpress.org. The plugin does not ping suchen.tv for updates (required for Plugin Check / directory review).
